nodes.label: Trunk-Based Development
nodes.rationale: Chosen so main is one branch to trust that always shows the latest approved version. Lower overhead than GitFlow for a solo founder (no long-lived develop branch to drift); main-only direct commits rejected because short-lived branches give a cheap review point before work becomes approved. Branches must stay short-lived (hours to days) or they defeat the model.

nodes.label: Semantic Versioning
